criteria.text: The participant has histological or cytological confirmation of NSCLC.

criteria.text: The participant has Clinical Stage II-IIIB (N0, N1, N2) NSCLC treated with presurgical chemoimmunotherapy, with residual tumor present at time of surgery, and does not have a pathologic complete response.

criteria.text: The participant had any immune-related side effect or allergic reaction (Grade 3 or higher) from a previous immunotherapy medicine, or any immune-related side effect greater than Grade 1 that has not resolved, unless they have hormone-related diseases who are now on stable hormone replacement therapy.
